note: Johnson County WY parcels are not published as a queryable service I could find. The statewide WY_PRIVATE_PARCELS MapServer layer 0 lists no layers and refuses every query (spatial, attribute, and paged requests return 'Unable to complete operation' or 'Pagination is not supported'); spec validation failed its query check. The county's own MapServer (maps.terragis.net/johnson, formerly maps.greenwoodmap.com/johnson) is a viewer with no discoverable REST endpoint (404 on rest/services and MapServer paths; greenwoodmap host unreachable). Remaining leads are commercial parcel vendors only.
